OUR STORY

A family table, open to everyone

Brothers Kitchen & Family Restaurant is a casual, affordable, home-style multi-cuisine spot, serving Indian, Indo-Chinese, and all-day breakfast, built for solo diners, big groups, and families with kids alike.

Since opening in 2024, the kitchen has built its name on three signatures: Matka Chicken, Bamboo Biryani, and a thali that starts at just ₹80. Beyond everyday dining, Brothers Kitchen regularly hosts birthdays, anniversaries, kitty parties, and family get-togethers.
